languages.bonus: Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Terran, Undercommon

traits.name: Slow and Steady
traits.summary: Base speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Defensive Training
traits.summary: Gain +4 dodge AC against monsters of the giant subtype.

traits.name: Greed
traits.summary: Gain +2 Appraise to determine the price of nonmagical goods containing precious metals or gemstones.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.summary: Gain +1 on attacks against humanoids of the orc and goblinoid subtypes.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.summary: Gain +2 on saves against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Stability
traits.summary: Gain +4 CMD against bull rush and trip while standing on the ground.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.summary: Gain +2 Perception to notice unusual stonework and automatically check within 10 feet.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.summary: Treat dwarven weapons as martial and gain the traditional dwarven weapon proficiencies.

alternateTraits.name: Ancient Enmity
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +1 on attack rolls against humanoids of the elf subtype.

alternateTraits.name: Craftsman
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 on Craft or Profession checks that create objects from metal or stone.

alternateTraits.name: Deep Warrior
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 dodge AC against aberrations and +2 CMB to grapple them.

alternateTraits.name: Lorekeeper
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 on Knowledge (history) about dwarves or their enemies and make those checks untrained.

alternateTraits.name: Magic Resistant
alternateTraits.summary: Gain spell resistance 5 + level, which can be lowered for 1 round, but take -2 on arcane concentration checks.

alternateTraits.name: Relentless
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 CMB on bull rush and overrun while both creatures stand on the ground.

alternateTraits.name: Stonesinger
alternateTraits.summary: Count as one level higher for earth spells and specified earth-themed class powers.

alternateTraits.name: Stubborn
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 on Will saves against charm and compulsion and a second save 1 round after a failed save.
